g.text: When RGB clipping erases an entire shading pattern
The broad light/dark shape is carried only by P3 red intensity.
In linear sRGB every pixel has R > 1, G < 0, B < 0.
Clipping all three channels therefore makes every pixel (1, 0, 0).

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
